name: @hcm/engine
description: Public viewer engine: builds dist/engine.{iife.js,mjs,css} (global window.HistoricCityMap; the IIFE loads its extras dist/extra-<name>-<hash>.js with their integrity) and copies the kit's self-hosted fonts to dist/fonts/. Mapbox GL is external (global mapboxgl from api.mapbox.com v3.34.1).

scripts.build: vite build && vite build --mode iife && npm run fonts:copy
